{{Quote|I'll hire us a Livery Cruiser. No big deal. It won't come out of your end. I'll pay for it. I'm just trying to make it pleasant.|A Mythrol, to Din Djarin|audio=MythrolCruiser-TMS01CH01.flac|<ref name="Chapter 1" />}}
A '''Livery Cruiser''' was a class of [[cruiser]] that was used during the [[New Republic Era]]. It was considered more "pleasant" for [[Realspace|interstellar]] travel than [[gunship]]s such as the ''[[Razor Crest]]''.<ref name="Chapter 1" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|1|the mention of the Livery Cruiser}}</ref> a [[The Fledgling Mythrol|Mythrol]] on the [[Water|ice]] [[planet]] of [[Pagodon]] attempted to ingratiate [[Gender|himself]] to his captor—the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]]—by suggesting that he could hail a Livery Cruiser for them.<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Livery Cruisers were mentioned in dialogue in the [[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian|first episode]] of the [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'',<ref name="Chapter 1" /> which aired on [[November 12]], 2019.<ref name="Airdate">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|date=2019-09-24|format=[[Wikipedia:PDF|PDF]]|work=[[Wikipedia:Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International|Walt Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]]|pages=[https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf#page=1]|archivedate=20210623202717}}</ref>
